sentences.en: Car? Ah, if you mean that limousine, - I chartered it.
sentences.zh: 汽车？哦，如果你指的是那辆豪华轿车——我包租了它。

sentences.en: They will dispatch four charter buses to pick everyone up.
sentences.zh: 他们会派四辆包车来接大家。

sentences.en: The charter flight is to take off at three.
